description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I: Ashe] and [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I: Ashe
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Thundering Heavens after using Lightning abilities (up to 3 times)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II: Ashe], removes [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I: Ashe]

description.name: Instant ATB 1

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II: Ashe

description.name: Dual Thundering Heavens

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
